package courseplan

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/pedagogy"
)

type Processor struct {
	Requests             repository.CoursePlanRepository
	Graphs               repository.GoalGraphRepository
	Policies             repository.PolicyRepository
	Students             domainservice.StudentService
	Courses              domainservice.CourseService
	Generator            domainservice.ContentGenerator
	IDs                  IDGenerator
	Clock                Clock
	Strategies           pedagogy.Registry
	DiagnosticPlans      repository.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRepository
	DiagnosticPlacements repository.DiagnosticPlacementRepository
	InitialAllocations   repository.DiagnosticInitialAllocationRepository
	LeaseTTL             time.Duration
	MaxAttempts          int
}

func (processor Processor) ProcessNext(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
	if processor.Requests == nil || processor.Graphs == nil || processor.Policies == nil ||
		processor.Students == nil || processor.Courses == nil || processor.Generator == nil || processor.IDs == nil || processor.Clock == nil ||
		processor.LeaseTTL <= 0 || processor.MaxAttempts < 1 {
		return false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	now := processor.Clock.Now().UTC()
	request, err := processor.Requests.ClaimNext(ctx, processor.IDs.NewID(), now, now.Add(processor.LeaseTTL))
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return false, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if err := processor.processClaimed(ctx, &request); err != nil {
		return true, err
	}
	return true, nil
}

func (processor Processor) processClaimed(ctx context.Context, request *domain.CoursePlanRequest) error {
	if request.DiagnosticPlanID != "" && processor.InitialAllocations != nil {
		checkpoint, err := processor.InitialAllocations.GetInitialAllocation(ctx, *request)
		if err == nil {
			if err := processor.restorePinnedAudit(ctx, request); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			return processor.dispatchInitialAllocation(ctx, request, checkpoint)
		}
		if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
				return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "INITIAL_ALLOCATION_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
			}
			return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "INITIAL_ALLOCATION_CHECKPOINT_UNAVAILABLE", err)
		}
		if request.LearningPathID != "" {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "INITIAL_ALLOCATION_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
		}
	}
	if request.LearningPathCommand != nil {
		if err := processor.restorePinnedAudit(ctx, request); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return processor.dispatchCheckpointedLearningPathCommand(ctx, request)
	}
	pinnedRepository, ok := processor.Requests.(repository.PinnedCoursePlanRepository)
	if !ok {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "PLANNING_CHECKPOINT_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	input, inputErr := pinnedRepository.GetPlanningInput(ctx, *request)
	if inputErr == nil {
		if input.Validate(*request) != nil {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "PLANNING_INPUT_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
		}
		return processor.processPinned(ctx, request, input, pinnedRepository)
	}
	if !errors.Is(inputErr, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		if errors.Is(inputErr, domain.ErrValidation) {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "PLANNING_INPUT_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
		}
		return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "PLANNING_INPUT_CHECKPOINT_UNAVAILABLE", inputErr)
	}
	if len(request.GeneratedCourseJSON) > 0 {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "LEGACY_GENERATED_COURSE_UNBOUND")
	}
	var diagnosticPlan domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan
	var diagnosticRecord domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord
	var diagnosticRoute string
	if request.DiagnosticPlanID != "" {
		if processor.DiagnosticPlans == nil || processor.DiagnosticPlacements == nil {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_INVALID")
		}
		record, err := processor.DiagnosticPlans.GetDiagnosticByID(ctx, request.DiagnosticPlanID)
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_INVALID")
		}
		if err != nil {
			return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE", err)
		}
		if domain.ValidateDiagnosticPlanRecord(record) != nil || record.Plan.StudentID != request.StudentID || record.BindingGoalCode != request.GoalCode {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_INVALID")
		}
		placement, err := processor.DiagnosticPlacements.GetDiagnosticPlacement(ctx, request.DiagnosticPlanID)
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "DIAGNOSTIC_PLACEMENT_PENDING", err)
		}
		if err != nil {
			return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "DIAGNOSTIC_PLACEMENT_UNAVAILABLE", err)
		}
		if domain.ValidateStoredDiagnosticPlacement(placement.Decision, record.Plan, placement.RequestID, placement.RequestHash, placement.Decision.DecisionDigest) != nil {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_INVALID")
		}
		diagnosticPlan, diagnosticRecord, diagnosticRoute = record.Plan, record, placement.Decision.RouteCode
	}
	graph, err := processor.Graphs.GetPublishedGoalGraph(ctx, request.GoalCode)
	if err != nil {
		return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "GOAL_GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	graph, err = SelectRequestedTargetClosure(graph, request.Intent.RequestedTargets)
	if err != nil {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "REQUESTED_TARGETS_INVALID")
	}
	policy, err := processor.Policies.GetActivePolicyBundle(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "POLICY_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	var learningPathState *domain.LearningPathPlanningState
	if request.LearningPathID != "" {
		if err := processor.renewClaim(ctx, *request); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		state, err := processor.Students.GetLearningPathPlanningState(ctx, request.StudentID, request.LearningPathID)
		if err != nil {
			return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "LEARNING_PATH_UNAVAILABLE", err)
		}
		if state.GoalCode != request.GoalCode {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "LEARNING_PATH_MISMATCH")
		}
		learningPathState = &state
	} else if request.Intent.Reason == domain.PlanningReasonReplan {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "LEARNING_PATH_REQUIRED")
	}
	if err := processor.renewClaim(ctx, *request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	profile, err := processor.Students.GetPlanningProfile(ctx, request.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "STUDENT_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	if request.DiagnosticPlanID != "" && (profile.OnboardingVersion != diagnosticPlan.OnboardingVersion || profile.GoalCode != diagnosticRecord.BindingGoalCode || profile.DirectionCode != diagnosticRecord.BindingDirectionCode || diagnosticRoute == "") {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_INVALID")
	}
	profile.GoalCode = request.GoalCode
	if request.Intent.Constraints.Language != "" {
		profile.PreferredLanguage = request.Intent.Constraints.Language
	}
	if request.Intent.Constraints.WeeklyMinutes != 0 {
		profile.WeeklyMinutes = request.Intent.Constraints.WeeklyMinutes
	}
	if request.Intent.Constraints.PreferredPace != "" {
		profile.PreferredPace = request.Intent.Constraints.PreferredPace
	}
	targets := make([]domain.TargetRef, len(graph.Targets))
	for index, target := range graph.Targets {
		targets[index] = target.Ref
	}
	mastery, err := processor.queryMastery(ctx, *request, request.StudentID, targets)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
			return err
		}
		return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "MASTERY_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	result, err := BuildDeterministicCourseForDiagnosticRoute(graph, profile, mastery, policy, request.Intent, diagnosticRoute, processor.Strategies)
	if err != nil {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, domain.CoursePlanFailureInvalidGraph)
	}
	originalPathID := request.LearningPathID
	if request.Intent.Reason == domain.PlanningReasonInitial {
		originalPathID = ""
	}
	input, err = domain.NewPlanningInputCheckpoint(domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint{
		RequestID: request.ID, StudentID: request.StudentID, RequestHash: request.RequestHash,
		GoalCode: request.GoalCode, Intent: request.Intent,
		DiagnosticPlanID: request.DiagnosticPlanID, DiagnosticRoute: diagnosticRoute,
		ExpectedOnboardingVersion: diagnosticPlan.OnboardingVersion,
		ExpectedDirectionCode:     diagnosticRecord.BindingDirectionCode,
		OriginalLearningPathID:    originalPathID, OriginalPath: learningPathState,
		Profile: profile, Mastery: mastery, Graph: graph, Policy: policy,
		Draft: result.Course, Fingerprint: result.Fingerprint,
		NormalizedContext: result.NormalizedContext, GapTargets: result.GapTargets,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "PLANNING_INPUT_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
	}
	if err := processor.renewClaim(ctx, *request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := pinnedRepository.CheckpointPlanningInput(ctx, *request, input, processor.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return processor.processPinned(ctx, request, input, pinnedRepository)
}

func (p Processor) dispatchInitialAllocation(ctx context.Context, r *domain.CoursePlanRequest, c domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint) error {
	if c.Validate(*r) != nil {
		return p.failPermanent(ctx, *r, "INITIAL_ALLOCATION_CHECKPOINT_INVALID")
	}
	if err := p.renewClaim(ctx, *r); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := p.Students.AssignCourse(ctx, r.StudentID, c.Replacement.CourseID, r.ID, r.ID); err != nil {
		return p.handleFailure(ctx, *r, "ASSIGNMENT_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	if err := p.renewClaim(ctx, *r); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	allocation, err := p.Students.CreateLearningPath(ctx, r.StudentID, r.ID, c.Replacement)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrDiagnosticContextStale) {
			return p.failPermanent(ctx, *r, "DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_INVALID")
		}
		return p.handleFailure(ctx, *r, "LEARNING_PATH_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	if allocation.StudentID != r.StudentID || allocation.CourseID != c.Replacement.CourseID || allocation.GoalCode != r.GoalCode || allocation.CourseFingerprint != c.Replacement.CourseFingerprint || allocation.LearningPathID == "" || (r.LearningPathID != "" && r.LearningPathID != allocation.LearningPathID) {
		return p.failPermanent(ctx, *r, "INITIAL_ALLOCATION_RECEIPT_INVALID")
	}
	r.LearningPathID = allocation.LearningPathID
	if err := p.Requests.ResolveLearningPath(ctx, r.ID, r.ClaimToken, r.LearningPathID, p.Clock.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r.CourseID = c.Replacement.CourseID
	r.CourseFingerprint = c.Replacement.CourseFingerprint
	r.FingerprintVersion = domain.CourseFingerprintVersion
	r.Reused = c.Reused
	r.ResultCode = domain.CoursePlanResultCreated
	if c.Reused {
		r.ResultCode = domain.CoursePlanResultReused
	}
	return p.Requests.Complete(ctx, *r, r.ClaimToken, p.Clock.Now().UTC())
}

func (processor Processor) checkpointAndDispatchLearningPathCommand(
	ctx context.Context,
	request *domain.CoursePlanRequest,
	checkpoint domain.LearningPathCommandCheckpoint,
) error {
	request.LearningPathCommand = &checkpoint
	request.ResultCode = ""
	request.CourseID = ""
	request.Reused = false
	if err := processor.Requests.CheckpointLearningPathCommand(
		ctx, *request, request.ClaimToken, processor.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return processor.dispatchCheckpointedLearningPathCommand(ctx, request)
}

func (processor Processor) dispatchCheckpointedLearningPathCommand(
	ctx context.Context,
	request *domain.CoursePlanRequest,
) error {
	if request.LearningPathCommand == nil {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, domain.CoursePlanFailureCheckpoint)
	}
	checkpoint, err := domain.NormalizeLearningPathCommandCheckpoint(
		*request.LearningPathCommand, request.StudentID, request.ID, request.LearningPathID,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, domain.CoursePlanFailureCheckpoint)
	}
	request.LearningPathCommand = &checkpoint
	if err := processor.renewClaim(ctx, *request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	switch checkpoint.Command {
	case domain.LearningPathCommandReplan:
		command, decodeErr := domain.DecodeLearningPathReplanCheckpoint(
			checkpoint, request.StudentID, request.ID, request.LearningPathID,
		)
		if decodeErr != nil {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, domain.CoursePlanFailureCheckpoint)
		}
		_, err = processor.Students.ReplanLearningPath(ctx, request.StudentID, request.ID, command)
	case domain.LearningPathCommandNoGap:
		command, decodeErr := domain.DecodeLearningPathNoGapCheckpoint(
			checkpoint, request.StudentID, request.ID, request.LearningPathID,
		)
		if decodeErr != nil {
			return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, domain.CoursePlanFailureCheckpoint)
		}
		_, err = processor.Students.CompleteLearningPath(ctx, request.StudentID, request.ID, command)
	default:
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, domain.CoursePlanFailureCheckpoint)
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, domain.CoursePlanFailurePathConflict)
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		return processor.failPermanent(ctx, *request, "LEARNING_PATH_COMMAND_INVALID_RESPONSE")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return processor.handleFailure(ctx, *request, "LEARNING_PATH_COMMAND_UNAVAILABLE", err)
	}
	request.ResultCode = checkpoint.PlannedResultCode
	request.CourseID = checkpoint.PlannedCourseID
	request.Reused = checkpoint.PlannedReused
	if err := processor.renewClaim(ctx, *request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return processor.Requests.Complete(ctx, *request, request.ClaimToken, processor.Clock.Now().UTC())
}

func (processor Processor) queryMastery(
	ctx context.Context,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
	studentID string,
	targets []domain.TargetRef,
) ([]domain.TargetMastery, error) {
	result := make([]domain.TargetMastery, 0, len(targets))
	for start := 0; start < len(targets); start += 100 {
		if err := processor.renewClaim(ctx, request); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		end := start + 100
		if end > len(targets) {
			end = len(targets)
		}
		items, err := processor.Students.QueryMastery(ctx, studentID, targets[start:end])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, items...)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (processor Processor) renewClaim(ctx context.Context, request domain.CoursePlanRequest) error {
	now := processor.Clock.Now().UTC()
	return processor.Requests.RenewClaim(ctx, request.ID, request.ClaimToken, now, now.Add(processor.LeaseTTL))
}

func (processor Processor) handleFailure(
	ctx context.Context,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
	code string,
	cause error,
) error {
	now := processor.Clock.Now().UTC()
	if request.Attempts >= processor.MaxAttempts {
		if err := processor.Requests.Fail(ctx, request, request.ClaimToken, domain.CoursePlanFailureAttempts, now); err != nil {
			return errors.Join(cause, err)
		}
		return cause
	}
	delay := time.Duration(request.Attempts*request.Attempts) * time.Second
	if delay > time.Minute {
		delay = time.Minute
	}
	if err := processor.Requests.Retry(ctx, request, request.ClaimToken, now.Add(delay), now); err != nil {
		return errors.Join(cause, err)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", code, cause)
}

func (processor Processor) failPermanent(
	ctx context.Context,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
	code string,
) error {
	now := processor.Clock.Now().UTC()
	if err := processor.Requests.Fail(ctx, request, request.ClaimToken, code, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", code, domain.ErrValidation)
}

// preserveAssignmentIdentities pairs repeated exact revisions in route order.
// New revisions receive new Student-owned IDs instead of reusing an old execution.
func preserveAssignmentIdentities(items, previous []domain.LearningPathItem) []domain.LearningPathItem {
	used := make(map[string]bool)
	for i := range items {
		for _, old := range previous {
			if old.LearningPathItemID != "" && !used[old.LearningPathItemID] &&
				old.ReferenceType == items[i].ReferenceType && old.ReferenceID == items[i].ReferenceID &&
				old.LessonRevisionID == items[i].LessonRevisionID {
				items[i].LearningPathItemID = old.LearningPathItemID
				used[old.LearningPathItemID] = true
				break
			}
		}
	}
	return items
}
